answer: Give every newcomer a seat through an auction of fifty onboarding slots. First, each applicant posts a sealed bid plus a ten-token bond. Second, the fifty highest bids win, each paying the second-highest price, so honest agents pay the true market price. Third, winners' bonds stay locked twenty epochs and burn on any proven fraud. A 1,000-clone farm must outbid real agents a thousand times, spending roughly $8,000, while one honest agent pays a few dollars. At its zenith, the economy is an ivory tower with one quill: a single hand signs each name, and a forger must buy the whole tower.
